termsModal.title: Terms and Conditions
termsModal.intro: Welcome to {{appName}}. By creating an account, you agree to these Terms and Conditions of use. Please read them carefully before continuing.
termsModal.section1Text: {{appName}} is a personal payment and financial commitment tracking app. Its purpose is to help you organize and remember your payments according to your pay period. {{appName}} is not a financial institution, doesn't manage real money, doesn't make transfers, and has no access to your bank accounts.
termsModal.section2Text: To use {{appName}} you must create an account with a valid email or through your Google account. You're responsible for keeping your access credentials confidential. You must be over 18 years old to register.
termsModal.section3Text: You agree to use {{appName}} only for personal, lawful purposes. It is prohibited to use the app for fraudulent activities, impersonation, or attempts to compromise the system's security.
termsModal.section4Text: The data you enter into {{appName}} (name, payments, amounts) is stored securely on Supabase servers. We don't sell or share your personal information with third parties for commercial purposes. You can delete your account and your data at any time from Settings.
termsModal.section5Text: If you turn on notifications, {{appName}} will send alerts related to your recorded payments. You can turn them off at any time from Settings or from your device's settings.
termsModal.section6Text: {{appName}} is a personal support tool. We don't guarantee that using the app will prevent late payments, late fees, or other financial consequences. The user is solely responsible for their financial decisions.
termsModal.section7Text: We strive to keep the service available at all times, but we don't guarantee uninterrupted availability. We may perform maintenance or updates without prior notice.
termsModal.section8Text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. We'll notify you of significant changes through the app. Continued use of {{appName}} after changes implies your acceptance.
termsModal.section9Text: You can stop using {{appName}} and delete your account at any time. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms.
termsModal.section10Text: If you have questions about these terms, you can contact us through the channels available in the app.
termsModal.closing: By creating your account, you confirm that you have read and accept these Terms and Conditions.

metricCard.title: Your pay period at a glance
metricCard.text: See how much you need to pay this period. Tap "Period" or "Month" to change the view.

addButton.title: Add your first payment
addButton.text: Everything starts here — from this button you log any expense, one-time, recurring, or in installments.

rail.title: Your pay period timeline
rail.text: Each dot is a payment. The color tells you if it's overdue, due this period, or due next period.

paidCollapse.title: What you've already paid
paidCollapse.text: It's saved here, collapsed, to stay out of your way — but you can check it or undo it anytime.

tabs.title: 3 ways to log a payment
tabs.text: "One-time" is a single expense. "Recurring" repeats every week/two weeks/month. "Installments" is for payments split into a fixed number of payments.

category.title: Choose or create a category
category.text: Each category has its own icon and color — you can customize them later from Settings.

variable.title: Does the amount change every time?
variable.text: Turn this on for payments like electricity or water, where you don't know the exact amount until the bill arrives.

disponible.title: What you have available
disponible.text: See how much you have left this period, based on your income (if set up) plus any extra income you log.

addIncome.title: Log your income
addIncome.text: Freelance work, a bonus, or leftover from last period? Add it here so your available amount is accurate.

categoryChips.title: Filter by category
categoryChips.text: Tap any of these to see only those expenses in the chart below.

monthlyChart.title: Your monthly trend
monthlyChart.text: Compare how much you've spent month to month — useful for spotting patterns.

stats.title: Your active payments, at a glance
stats.text: See how many recurring payments you have active or paused, and how much they add up to per month.

filtroTipo.title: Recurring vs. Installments
filtroTipo.text: A recurring payment has no end date (like Netflix). An installment does — a fixed number of payments, like a phone paid over 12 months.

cobro.title: Set up your pay period
cobro.text: Define how often you get paid — weekly, biweekly, or monthly — so the app organizes everything around it.

categorias.title: Make categories your own
categorias.text: Change the icon and color of any category, or create your own.

notificaciones.title: Never miss a payment
notificaciones.text: Turn on reminders so the app lets you know before each payment is due.
